subject: Onsite workshop — coordinating attendee windows & AV requirements
messages:
From: Erin Su <erin.su@aegis-fin.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Bartlett <tbartlett@elara-consulting.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — week of Dec 7 (initial ask)

Hi Laura and Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs at Aegis want to run a two-day technical workshop + executive briefing the week of Dec 7 in our New York office. High-level asks:

- Day 1: technical deep-dive (SRE, data security, integration patterns) — ~25 engineers (NY time).
- Day 2: exec briefing + live demo for leadership — ~12 execs, prefer morning slot (9:00–11:30 ET).
- We have two folks joining remotely from London and Stockholm — they'd like a streaming-friendly setup and dial-in around 14:00 GMT.

Can your team confirm availability and provide an AV checklist and any constraints for bringing two Redwood engineers onsite? Also attaching a preliminary attendee list — please confirm if you need anything else from procurement.

Thanks,
Erin
--
Erin Su
Director, Platform Engineering | Aegis Financial
erin.su@aegis-fin.com
+1 (212) 555-0189

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Su <erin.su@aegis-fin.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — week of Dec 7 (initial ask)

Hi Erin — this sounds great, we're excited to run it. Quick notes and asks from our side: 

- Redwood team availability: Marissa (CS lead) and I can be onsite Dec 8–9. Jordan (operations) can support logistics and AV.
- For remote attendees: we'll run the demo with a low-latency stream and provide captions where possible; please confirm whether the remote attendees need breakout rooms or will only watch the main session.
- Could you send a final attendee matrix with titles and timezone offsets (e.g., "Alice — London — GMT+0") so we can plan demo windows? The attached CSV had emails but not timezones.
- AV checklist request: projectors, HDMI + USB-C adapters, wired Ethernet for demo laptop, separate mics for panel speakers, room capacity (25). If you can confirm room name we can map our AV spec.

I'll draft calendar holds (tentative) once we confirm final times — do you prefer all-day holds or specific windows per session?

Best,
Laura
--
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Su <erin.su@aegis-fin.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — AV & ops notes

Hi Erin — looping in ops details. A few practical items from Redwood Ops: 

1) Equipment and AV: I've attached our Redwood projector spec (redwood_av_projector_spec.pdf). We support HDMI & USB-C; please ensure at least one wired Ethernet drop in the room for a demo laptop. If the room has only Wi‑Fi, ask for a hardline in advance.

2) Demo laptop / environment: for the live demo we'll bring a dedicated laptop with preloaded model weights and an offline fallback container. If possible, schedule a 30-minute tech check the afternoon before Day 1 (Dec 7 evening or Dec 8 morning).

3) Onsite headcount & travel windows: Two Redwood engineers will travel from SF — earliest departure Dec 7 AM, return Dec 10 PM. We can do an evening arrival on Dec 7 or early morning on Dec 8. Please confirm which option is easiest for your onsite sponsor.

4) Breakouts & recording: If you want recordings available immediately after sessions, we can publish trimmed clips the same day; requires a room laptop to capture the feed.

I'll add tentative calendar blocks for the following (subject to your confirmation):
- Dec 8, 09:00–12:30 ET — Technical deep-dive (room A)
- Dec 9, 09:00–11:30 ET — Exec briefing + demo (room A)
- Dec 8, 16:00–16:30 ET — Tech check (remote + onsite)

Jordan Blake
Director, Field Operations | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

From: Erin Su <erin.su@aegis-fin.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aegis Procurement <procurement@aegis-fin.com>, Tom Bartlett <tbartlett@elara-consulting.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 14:47:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — attendee updates and procurement contact

Laura / Jordan — thanks for the checklist and windows, that all looks good. Quick updates: 

- We've attached an updated attendee matrix (aegis_workshop_attendee_list.csv) with timezones and titles. Two UK-based engineers will dial in (GMT+0); one vendor (Tom) will be in the room as a facilitator.
- Procurement contact is procurement@aegis-fin.com — please CC them on any invoices/expense requests.
- Room: "Aegis HQ — Conference Room A" (capacity 30) — Ethernet port confirmed.
- Tech check: Dec 8 at 16:00 ET works best for our AV team.

One ask from leadership: could Redwood provide a 30-minute optional pre-brief for execs on Dec 9 at 08:15 ET to prep for the demo (non-technical)? If you can hold that slot we will invite ~8 execs.

Thanks,
Erin

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Su <erin.su@aegis-fin.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@aegis-fin.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:06:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop — final holds & calendar invites

Hi Erin — all set on our side. Confirming the final schedule and calendar holds below (we've created tentative Google calendar invites and shared the Drive folder):

- Dec 8, 09:00–12:30 ET — Technical deep-dive (Aegis HQ — Conf Room A) — calendar hold sent to all attendees.
- Dec 8, 16:00–16:30 ET — Tech check (remote + onsite) — calendar invite sent to AV contacts.
- Dec 9, 08:15–08:45 ET — Exec pre-brief (optional) — invite sent to execs only.
- Dec 9, 09:00–11:30 ET — Exec briefing + demo (Aegis HQ — Conf Room A) — calendar hold sent.

Attachments included: aegis_workshop_attendee_list.csv, redwood_av_projector_spec.pdf, onboard_schedule_draft.ics (tentative holds). Please review the attendee matrix for any last-minute timezone corrections. Jordan — we'll plan to arrive evening of Dec 7; I'll share flight details once booked.

If procurement needs an invoice or travel estimate, loop me and Marissa and we'll expedite.

Appreciate the quick turn here — excited to run this with Aegis.

Best,
Laura
